cd "$(pwd)" && python3 tests/check_cadastro.py --stage 1 && echo "--- labels/ids ---" && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
h = open("cadastro.html", encoding="utf-8").read()
labels = dict(re.findall(r'<label for="([^"]+)"[^>]*>(.*?)</label>', h, re.S))
ids = re.findall(r'<input[^>]*id="([^"]+)"', h)
print("labels:", {k: v.strip() for k, v in labels.items()})
print("input ids:", ids)
print("every input labeled:", set(ids) <= set(labels))
print("no <script>:", "<script" not in h.lower())
print("no external refs:", not re.search(r'(?:src|href)\s*=\s*["\']https?:|stylesheet', h, re.I))
print("inline-only style blocks:", h.lower().count("<style"), "style,", h.lower().count("<link"), "link")
PY
